task_description: Restructure src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx into the FINAL TARGET two-column desktop workspace: LEFT = selected-place card (photo + lime #d1f470 number pill + name/address/metadata/attributes/description + the existing VayuLok AQI/PM2.5 environmental result system when a layer is active); RIGHT = map only with search bar + AQI|PM2.5 selector + single marker + Google attribution. Remove on-map Expand/Collapse + keyboard-expand, floating photo gallery, photo-count overlay, on-map place card, extra map controls. Resolve the heatmap conflict (overrides req 05): preserve scientific value variation at ~30% opacity instead of flattening to flat lime; lime applies to the selector chrome only. Keep the hero (src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx) unchanged. Work on branch feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign (extends PR #218); do not push.

verification.summary: FEAT-003 (geocoding-library fix) complete on branch feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign: imported the 'geocoding' library in the map init effect and construct Geocoder preferring (geocodingLib)?.Geocoder || legacy.Geocoder; added an ensureGeocoder() helper (mirroring ensurePlacesLibrary) used by the runSearch autocomplete->geocoding fallback so it no longer depends on a pre-seeded legacy.Geocoder; non-ZERO_RESULTS geocode statuses (REQUEST_DENIED / OVER_QUERY_LIMIT / INVALID_REQUEST / UNKNOWN_ERROR) now surface the existing 'unavailable' search status (amber retry, no red) instead of being swallowed; map-click reverse-geocode stays silent-on-failure, no crash. Honest degradation preserved (no unconditional importLibrary; all imports on existing keyed paths). Tests made production-like: installGoogleMaps records imported library names, importLibrary('geocoding') returns { Geocoder: FakeGeocoder }, and a seedNamespaceGeocoder:false opt proves the component obtains its Geocoder via importLibrary('geocoding') with google.maps.Geocoder undefined; added fallback-works and REQUEST_DENIED-surfaces-unavailable tests. Re-verified: npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint 0 errors / 203 pre-existing warnings (none new in the two changed files); npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx 22/22; full npm run test 911 passed / 3 skipped / 0 fail (+3 new geocoding tests). git diff --stat src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx empty (hero unchanged). Heatmap unchanged (real UAQI_RED_GREEN / PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN tiles, ~0.30 opacity, on user action, left-side result + legend); no fake gradient/CSS heat colors added. LIMITATION: live heatmap-tile HTTP success is NOT verifiable in sandbox/CI because the browser Maps key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* (live tiles/map/geocoding only load on a deployed origin); verified via typecheck/lint/vitest + production-like importLibrary('geocoding') tests + honest-degradation, not a live browser. Not pushed. --- Prior review-refinement cycle (2026-10-04-035200 APPROVED): addressed issue 1 (left-card real-Place metadata/attributes/description + honest supporting-info bullets, fetched only on the existing keyed search/select + map-click paths) and issue 2 (explicit PM2.5 'Current status' label with a status word derived from the existing severity band). Issue 3 is no-action-required (pre-existing tile key). Re-verified on branch feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign: npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint 0 errors / 203 pre-existing warnings (identical base-vs-working warning count, none new); VayuLokLive suite 19/19 pass (+2 new metadata-present/absent tests, PM2.5 'Current status' asserted); full npm run test 908 passed / 3 pre-existing skips / 0 fail. Hero src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx unchanged vs stack. Constraint spot-checks: HEATMAP_OPACITY=0.3; hue-collapsing filter + runtime overlay-lime class removed (only explanatory comment remains) so scientific value variation is preserved; expand/collapse + floating .vl-live-map-photos + photo-count-on-map all removed (0 matches); number pill is number-only (no 'photos' text); gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google] appear only in comments, never as CSS selectors; no red hex. Test quality: new tests drive the real search->select->layer flow and assert the AQI result (168/Moderate/health guidance) renders inside .vl-live-left .vl-live-layer-result, the PM2.5 swap, the number pill in .vl-live-left (and absent from .vl-live-right), and that Expand/Collapse buttons are gone while gestureHandling stays greedy and ImageMapType opacity is >0 and <1 - all would fail if the restructure were reverted. Docker build not applicable (static Next.js export; no project Dockerfile for this change). Not pushed.
